title: The Mesnevi, Book 1
author: Jalal al-Din Rumi (Redhouse trans)
description: The first book of Rumi's Mesnevi in Redhouse's translation. Stories, teachings and poetic reflections explore longing, spiritual transformation and the search for divine reality within the Sufi tradition.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB). Source text obtained from Project Gutenberg (https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/61724).
